title: Training record
purpose: Read one training assignment, its completion evidence and retained history.
summary: One training assignment, its completion evidence and its history.

tasks.title: Record completion
steps: Managers and administrators: select [[Record completion]] while it is Assigned.

tasks.title: Fix a mistake
steps: Select [[Edit]] before completion, or [[Correct training record]] after it.

tasks.title: End the record
steps: Select [[Cancel training record]] and give a reason.

good_to_know: Cancellation is final and keeps all completion evidence.
Earlier values stay in the history after every correction.
The record documents a human decision. The application does not certify competence.

sections.title: Access and meaning
paragraphs: All four application staff roles can read the list, record and history. Only administrators and repository managers create assignments, edit, complete, correct or cancel. Inactive accounts and accounts without an application role, including bare superusers, have no access. Managers may record their own training; this is recordkeeping without an independent approval step.

These are working product defaults, not repository policy. Training records retain evidence and human competency assessments. The software does not certify competence, grant permissions, determine expired qualifications or block specimen work. No attachments, automatic recurrence, notifications or fixed renewal interval are provided.

sections.title: Navigation and actions
paragraphs: Training records returns to the list. On-this-page links lead to Assignment, Completion, Record facts and History. Assignment shows the fixed trainee, topic, reference and due date. Completion shows the observed date, trainer/provider, evidence, optional human assessment and renewal date. Record facts show creation and latest update times and actors, plus revision. The header shows identifier, status, topic and revision; the footer identifies the viewed record.

While Assigned, Edit changes assignment metadata and Record completion records the completion evidence. While Completed, Correct training record changes metadata or completion fields with a reason. Cancel training record is available while Assigned or Completed and requires a reason. Cancellation is terminal and retains all completion evidence. Managers and administrators see these actions; other roles see read-only guidance. Cancelled records explain that further actions are unavailable.

History shows each saved action with its actor, server time, reason and previous/new field values. Prior evidence remains after corrections and cancellation. It records human decisions without certifying competence.

items.label: Trainee
items.description: Required when creating: choose an active account with an application staff role. Django administrative-site access is not required. The trainee cannot change after creation. For the wrong trainee, cancel this record with a reason and create a new assignment. Existing records remain readable and correctable after the trainee is deactivated or changes role.

items.label: Topic
items.description: Required concise training topic, up to 160 characters.

items.label: Procedure / version reference
items.description: Optional reference text, up to 240 characters. Record the relevant procedure and version if known. This is text only and does not link, validate or control a procedure.

items.label: Assignment due
items.description: Optional follow-up date entered by the repository. Past dates are allowed. It remains visible after completion and is not a completion deadline gate.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required for every saved action, up to 4,000 characters. Explain the assignment or change; it remains in history. Required text cannot be whitespace only. Text is trimmed before saving. Do not enter donor or participant identifying information.

items.label: Completed on
items.description: Required observed completion date when recording or correcting completion. It cannot be in the future in the repository time zone. It is separate from the server recording timestamp.

items.label: Trainer / provider
items.description: Required trainer or training provider text, up to 240 characters; it need not be an application account.

items.label: Completion evidence
items.description: Required narrative, up to 4,000 characters. Describe the evidence for completion; no attachment is uploaded.

items.label: Competency assessment
items.description: Optional narrative, up to 4,000 characters. Records a human assessment without software certification or an automatic pass/fail result.

items.label: Renewal due
items.description: Optional repository-chosen follow-up date on or after completion. No interval is supplied. A later assignment does not automatically clear an earlier completed record’s renewal date. After recording follow-up, a manager can correct or clear the earlier Renewal due with a reason; the old date remains in history.

sections.title: Saving and retained history
paragraphs: Every saved change commits the record, revision event and field audit together or saves nothing. History retains the action, actor, exact server recording timestamp, revision, reason and old and new values. Dates are shown as YYYY-MM-DD and recording times in the repository time zone. Records cannot be deleted; history cannot be rewritten.

Validation errors keep entered values. If another change was saved first, your submitted values remain visible and saving is blocked. Cancel, reopen the latest record, review its values and start again. An old form cannot overwrite the newer revision. No-change edits and corrections are rejected.
